title: ci-sentinel pinned CC below the floor; now it reads the floor live
description: Issue #4055: ci-sentinel.yml hardcoded claude-code 2.1.251 while shared/cc-support.json moved the floor to 2.1.277, so the headless sentinel never ran with PermissionRequest hooks (fire under -p from 2.1.268). The install step now reads supported_floor at run time. Drag the floor forward and watch the two pin styles diverge.
